entries.german:
Graf Emich v. Leiningen-Dagsburg bekundet, dass er dem Damian Kämmerer v. Worms, genannt v. Dalberg als Lehnsträger seines Bruders Johanns und der Söhne seines verstorbenen Bruders Friedrich, nämlich Wolf Friedrich und Balthasar,die Burg Erfenstein und das Dorf Esthal zu einem Mannlehen verliehen habe, wie es vorher Balthasar v. Rosenberg innehatte, und vorzeiten Hans v. Ingelheim von seinem verstorbenen Vater Graf Emich d.Ä. v. Leiningen

Siegler: Aussteller
entries.english:
Count Emich of Leiningen-Dagsburg certifies that he has enfeoffed Damian Kämmerer of Worms, called of Dalberg, as feudal holder on behalf of his brother Johann and the sons of his deceased brother Friedrich, namely Wolf Friedrich and Balthasar, with Erfenstein Castle and the village of Esthal as a male fief, as it was previously held by Balthasar von Rosenberg, and formerly by Hans of Ingelheim from his deceased father Count Emich the Elder of Leiningen

Seal: Issuer
